zh: 移动端真流式输出上线：iOS 切换为基于 URLSession 增量代理的无缓冲 NDJSON 流，搭配稳定消息主键实现真打字机逐字刷新。
手势方向锁与触控防误触优化：参考业界交互规范在 iOS 与 Android 双端引入方向锁定手势识别，彻底避免上下滚动与左右抽屉滑动同时触发。
对话输入区重构与语音波形条：采用极简无边框输入框与“+”悬浮功能菜单（相机/照片/文件/技能/压缩上下文），新增内嵌 32 通道动态点阵波形语音转写与直发。
移动端能力全量对齐与更名：iOS 展示名正式升级为 Dragon Claw，全面补齐会话归档/导出、定时任务管理及常用/最近工具双向同步。
en: True token-by-token mobile streaming: iOS now uses an incremental URLSession delegate for unbuffered NDJSON streaming with stable message identity.
Directional gesture axis-lock on iOS & Android: disambiguates vertical scrolling from horizontal drawer swipes to prevent simultaneous accidental drags.
Minimalist chat composer & dotted-waveform voice bar: redesigned borderless composer with a vertical '+' popover (Camera, Photos, Files, Skills, Compact) and inline 32-bar audio transcription.
Full mobile feature parity & Dragon Claw branding: renamed iOS app to Dragon Claw and added session archive/export, scheduled tasks, context compaction, and pinned/recent tool sync.
